prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Original medieval grounded RPG LOW RES PIXEL ART location concept, elevated three-quarter cutaway. Coarse square pixel clusters, controlled dark outlines, restrained 3-tone stone timber wool iron, muted earth palette, no smooth painted surfaces or photorealism. No people, no text or labels, no quest UI, no magic, no outcome animation. Daylight. Room/prop geometry is a proposal, not certified collision, official geography, inventory or narrative outcome. Open ordinary return path remains visually distinct. One raised stone observation gallery ABOVE two narrow separated canal channels, with a central dry embankment and landward exit at both ends. Two plain vertical timber water-gauge staffs, one beside a low house doorstep and one beside a higher cargo platform, show simple tick marks WITHOUT numerals. Old dark tide stains on the stone visibly differ from current lower water. A closed rope seal lies on a separate peg, no operator and no moving gates. Tiny distant low house door and cargo platform provide comparison, not flooded victims. No water splashing onto inhabited floors, no opened sluice, no new drainage completion. Emphasize dry rail-protected observation rather than the existing twin-gate machinery or sand model.
